svg.text: As decided 2026-08-18: one MCP hub, the wide→narrow gradient, an epoch-aware cache — and an observability stack that turned out to already exist, verified by live query.
LIVE — exists on host, access verified today
Selects and fills. Never authors a
flow, a command, or a conclusion.
THE OTHER DOORS — no model in them
CLI (human, direct) · route-event: syslog line / Alertmanager webhook → flow, deterministically (B-480)
THE MENU — a gradient the model walks, wide to narrow
decided: Option C, split by phase — and every side-effect lives behind a flow, never composed by the model
frame the problem, gather broadly, all side-effects
one domain, both readings: context AND one specific check
per-protocol adjacency: ISIS done · LDP · OSPF · MP-BGP · RSVP · CDP …
one subject, one rung, one verdict from parsed fields
investigate · get_bgp_neighbor · a single rung check
Fractal with the core: the same wide-then-narrow shape the descent already runs inside one investigate. History (below) feeds the WIDE step only — a trend is context, never a rung's verdict.
spin up docker; first flow list next
collector script feeds it from net
then a NetBox MCP -> LM Studio
Config is cached; a syslog config-change event invalidates it. Status is always collected.
THE RULE: a cached value's AGE counts against the coherence skew bound — the epoch
guarantee survives the cache or the cache does not ship. Later: fields may be qualified
always-cached, one reviewed decision per field. Expected-vs-observed diff falls out free (B-106).
OBSERVABILITY — DISCOVERED LIVE TODAY, ACCESS VERIFIED
Already flowing: IS-IS neighbour state (holdtime, uptime, adj-SIDs) and interface counters —
the utilisation / CPU / packet-drop HISTORY of the temporal axis exists before we build a line of it.
History is evidence about a WINDOW; a verdict is about an instant. Absence of a sample is never zero.
9 × IOS-XR (XRd) on 172.20.250.0/24 · syslog → .101 · gNMI → telegraf · SSH reads only through nettools' frozen allowlist — no config mode, no shell, four invariants unchanged
PE3↔P2 IS-IS break preserved as the isis-broken fixture — the config axis's first live demand
Option C, wide→narrow gradient · side-effects only behind flows · nobody on top — MCP is a hub
Cache is epoch-aware · neo4j is derived (v1: LLDP/CDP/ISIS collector script) · doc store: grep now, vector only when measured
GRACE is the prompt discipline (RACE vs P.E.N.E closed) · measure-first: seal a prediction, score the menu with the eval harness
Juniper out of scope · push to GitHub at every milestone · retire stale docs at milestone 0 (evidence-class documents stay)
· measure the context window (the 7-backend manifest cost)
· protocol expansion: LDP · LLDP · RSVP · OSPF · MP-BGP · CDP
· RR-aware TS agent flow · neo4j ontology (v2)
· round 6 + Q1 — still the owed measurement

The guarantee that survives every box on this page: no verdict is reached from anything but parsed, point-in-time device fields — the model selects and fills, history frames, flows act, and only a human scores the ledger.
